name: YoutarrMetadata
description: Maps a Youtarr channel download folder into a Jellyfin TV Shows library. Each YouTube channel folder becomes a Series; videos become Episodes grouped by upload year. Reads metadata from Youtarr NFO files. No API key required.
overview: Organizes Youtarr downloads as Series/Season/Episode in Jellyfin

versions.changelog: Initial release v1.0.0.0. Channel folders resolve as Series; videos resolve as Episodes grouped into year seasons. Per-video NFO metadata (title, plot, premiere date, genres, tags, YouTube ID). Channel artwork as Series poster and backdrop. Plugin configuration page with year-seasons toggle. File-only — no API key required.
